svg.title: NVIDIA candlesticks, Bollinger Bands and breakout markers
svg.desc: October to December 2025 daily open, high, low and close. Bands use a trailing 20-session mean plus or minus two population standard deviations. Triangles mark closes crossing outside a band from inside on the previous session; they are historical chart events, not executed trades. Source: Yahoo Finance.

g.text: Yahoo Finance | Historical signals, not executed trades
